WorkspaceListTable.emptyDescription: No workspaces have been created yet.

AddSSOProvider.dialogDescription: You can add a Single Sign-on provider via SAML 2.0. Either through a link to the metadata or by entering the metadata itself.

EditSAMLAttributeMapping.description: Define which information your SSO provider sends to us. The default values are already entered.

DeleteSSOProvider.dialogDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the SSO provider? This action cannot be undone.

XRAGUpload.title: XRAG upload
XRAGUpload.description: Drag an XRAG file here to upload it and install its content.
XRAGUpload.successUpload: XRAG "{{name}}" uploaded successfully. Depending on the size and type of the upload, it may take a few minutes before the changes take effect.

CreateUser.descriptionKey: Create an account with an email address. The person can set their own password using the one-time password reset key within 7 days via “Reset password” on the sign-in page. No email is sent.
CreateUser.errorCreate: The account could not be created. Check whether the email address is already in use and try again.
CreateUser.descriptionSuccess: The account was created. Copy the key and share it with the person along with their email address and the sign-in page link.
CreateUser.descriptionExpires: Valid until {{expires}}. The key can only be used once.
CreateUser.errorCopy: Copy failed. Please select and copy the key manually.

UserEditorAdmin.descriptionAdmin: This user is an administrator and has full access to all workspaces and settings.
UserEditorAdmin.descriptionUser: This user is not an administrator. Access is determined by their workspace permissions.
UserEditorAdmin.descriptionSession: Changes take effect when the user next signs in or their session is refreshed.
UserEditorAdmin.errorSave: Administrator rights could not be updated. Please try again.

ThemeEditorDiscardChanges.labelDiscardConfirm: All unsaved changes to logos, colors, and texts will be discarded.

ThemeEditor.descriptionColors: Choose the colors available for agents, document repositories and transcriptions. Changes to the palette do not recolor existing items.
ThemeEditor.descriptionEmptyColors: No colors are offered for selection. You can add a color or restore the default palette.
ThemeEditor.descriptionLogos: Without a custom logo, the system logo is shown everywhere. Your first logo applies to all languages. Additional language variants replace it only for their respective language.
ThemeEditor.errorValidation: Check color names, color values, and logos before saving.
ThemeEditor.errorSave: The theme could not be saved. Your changes have been kept. Please try again.

ThemeLogoEditor.errorImage: The logo could not be loaded. Upload it again if needed.
ThemeLogoEditor.descriptionUpload: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or SVG · up to 5 MB
ThemeLogoEditor.descriptionChooseFile: Upload a logo for this language.
ThemeLogoEditor.errorFile: Choose one PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or SVG image up to 5 MB.
ThemeLogoEditor.errorUpload: The logo could not be uploaded. Please try again.
ThemeLogoEditor.descriptionDefault: Default for all languages without their own logo

ThemeWelcomeEditor.descriptionText: Without custom text, the system texts are used. Your first text applies to all languages. Additional language variants replace it only for their respective language. Markdown is supported.
ThemeWelcomeEditor.errorValidation: The text must not exceed 20,000 characters per language.
ThemeWelcomeEditor.errorSave: The welcome text could not be saved. Your changes have been kept. Please try again.
ThemeWelcomeEditor.descriptionDefault: Default for all languages without their own text

ThemeOverview.descriptionEmptyColors: No colors are available for selection.
ThemeOverview.descriptionLogo: Your first logo becomes the default for all languages without their own variant. Removing all custom logos restores the system logo.
ThemeOverview.descriptionText: The welcome text appears on the home and sign-in pages. Your first text also applies to languages without their own variant. Without custom text, the system texts are used.
ThemeOverview.descriptionColors: The color palette is available for agents, document repositories, and transcriptions. Drag and drop colors to change their order.

ThemeLanguageAdd.descriptionLanguage: Choose the language for your logo or text. The first variant is also used for all languages without their own variant.

UserResetKey.descriptionLocal: Issue a new reset key valid for seven days. It is displayed here once. No email is sent. The existing password remains valid until it is successfully reset.
UserResetKey.descriptionSSO: This account uses SSO. Its password is managed by the sign-in provider; a local reset key is not available.
UserResetKey.descriptionConfirm: All previous unused reset keys will become invalid. Do you want to issue a new key?
UserResetKey.descriptionExpires: Valid until {{expires}}. Share this key securely with the person. It cannot be retrieved after closing.
UserResetKey.errorIssue: The key could not be issued. Check that the local account still exists and try again.
UserResetKey.errorCopy: Copy failed. Select the key and copy it manually.

SAMLMetadataDownload.errorDownload: The SAML metadata could not be downloaded. Check the instance SAML configuration and try again.
SAMLMetadataDownload.descriptionNotConfigured: SAML is not enabled for this instance yet. Enable SAML in the Auth service before requesting its metadata.
SAMLMetadataDownload.descriptionSuccess: The SAML service provider metadata was downloaded as an XML file.

AccessMessageDialog.descriptionText: Review and edit the message. Copy the text or open a draft in your email app. No email is sent automatically.
AccessMessageDialog.errorCopy: Could not copy. Please select and copy the text manually.

ThemeAccessMessageEditor.descriptionText: Subject and message for newly created users. Without a custom template, the German or English default is used. The first saved language is the fallback for languages without their own template. Remove all variants to restore the defaults.
ThemeAccessMessageEditor.descriptionPlaceholders: Available placeholders (plain text, no conditions or HTML):
ThemeAccessMessageEditor.errorValidation: Enter a subject and message and use only the listed placeholders. Maximum 300 characters for the subject and 10,000 for the message; no line breaks in the subject.
ThemeAccessMessageEditor.descriptionDefault: Default for all languages without their own text
ThemeAccessMessageEditor.descriptionPreview: Preview with example data. Actual account details are inserted when creating an access message.

page.cardUsersDescription: Manage the users of the box and assign them individual permissions per workspace.
page.cardWorkspacesDescription: Workspaces are the central organizational unit. Agents, document repositories and other resources are always assigned to a workspace.
page.cardSsoDescription: Configure Single Sign-on via SAML 2.0 so that users can sign in with their existing account.
page.cardXragDescription: Install agents, documents, models or update the entire box via an XRAG package.
page.cardAppearanceDescription: Customize the colors and appearance of the box to your liking.
page.cardConnectionsDescription: Manage OAuth apps and search connections centrally.

workspace.page.helpDescription: Workspaces are the central organizational unit. Agents, document repositories, etc. are always assigned to a workspace. Users have individual permissions per workspace.

userDetail.page.ssoDescription: Permissions are managed by the SSO provider.

sso.page.inactiveDescription: You can add a Single Sign-on provider via SAML 2.0.

models.descriptionLocal: Local models registered on this instance. Select a model to view its details.
models.descriptionExternal: Connect external language models to your instance.
models.descriptionCloud: Your AI. Hosted entirely in Austria.
models.descriptionCompatible: Connect your own provider through an OpenAI-compatible API.
models.descriptionNoLocal: Local models are registered through your instance’s model deployment, for example using an XRAG package.
models.descriptionNoExternal: Add an OpenAI-compatible model to use it in agents.
models.descriptionAdd: Enter your provider’s connection details. Using this model sends conversation content to that provider.

descriptions.baseUrl: HTTPS API address, including its version path, e.g. /v1.
descriptions.apiKey: Stored only on the server and never displayed. Leave empty if the provider does not require a key.

models.errorAdd: The model could not be saved. Check your input and try again.
models.descriptionNoResults: Adjust your search to find models.
models.descriptionNoModels: Local and external models appear here. Add an external model to get started.
models.descriptionChooseProvider: Connect an external language model with its provider.
models.descriptionConfigure: Enter your credentials first, then the model identifier.
models.descriptionKeepKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The model list automatically uses saved credentials. After changing the address or region, save first or enter a new key.
models.descriptionBedrockKey: Use an Amazon Bedrock API key for this AWS region.
models.descriptionAzureDeployment: Enter your Azure deployment name. The model catalog does not list your deployments.
models.descriptionBedrockModel: Model discovery requires ListFoundationModels and ListInferenceProfiles permissions. You can also enter a model or inference profile ID manually.
models.descriptionModelDiscovery: Available models load after entering credentials. You can also enter the identifier manually.
models.errorDiscovery: Could not load models. Check your credentials or enter the identifier manually.
models.descriptionDocumentation: Markdown is supported. This documentation appears in the expanded model information, for example in agents.
models.descriptionDeleteExternal: The model entry and its saved API key will be deleted. Agents and roles using this model will need another model.
models.descriptionDeleteLocal: Only the database entry will be deleted. Local model files and running services remain. Agents and roles using this model will need another model.
models.descriptionEnterModelIdentifier: Enter a model identifier or load models.
models.descriptionEditConnection: Refresh the model list or edit the connection and model identifier.
models.descriptionDeleteAgents: Agents that use this model are retained. However, they cannot be used again until you assign them another available model.
models.descriptionDeleteAgentsTip: Tip: In the agent overview, open “Options” and group by “Model”. Affected agents appear in the “Unknown model” groups.

connections.descriptionEmpty: Create an OAuth app or a Staan/Brave search connection to select in agents.
connections.descriptionDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Agents using this connection must select another one. Personal authorizations are not revoked at the provider.
connections.descriptionSecret: Stored only on the server. Leave blank to keep the existing API key.
connections.descriptionCallback: Register this callback URL with the provider: {{url}}
connections.errorSave: Could not save. Check required fields, HTTPS URL and credentials. Search providers and GitHub require a secret.
connections.descriptionInfo: Global administrators manage reusable OAuth apps and search credentials here. Workspace administrators select them in agents. Personal OAuth sign-ins remain under Profile → Connections.
connections.descriptionChooseType: Choose the type of connection, then enter the corresponding credentials.
connections.descriptionNoResults: Adjust your search to find connections.
connections.errorDelete: The connection could not be deleted. Please try again.
connections.descriptionOAuthSecret: Stored only on the server and cannot be changed after creation.
connections.descriptionIssuer: Exact issuer URL of the provider where the client ID is registered. Once set, it cannot be changed. Add it to existing apps that have no issuer.

service.descriptionMachines: Current metrics for the entire machine. The last received values remain visible when a connection is interrupted.
service.descriptionNoMachines: Configure sharing.url and the sharing token in the service. Connected machines will appear here automatically.
service.descriptionDisconnected: Establishing the live connection. Displayed status data may be outdated.

artifacts.descriptionArtifacts: Files published through XRAG uploads. Deleting stops distribution and frees central storage. Installed files and model definitions are preserved.
artifacts.descriptionDelete: “{{name}}” will no longer be distributed and its stored file will be permanently deleted. Already installed files are preserved. New or previously offline machines can no longer obtain this artifact.
artifacts.descriptionDeleteLatest: This is the current setup. Deleting it will not activate an older setup as a replacement.
artifacts.errorDelete: The file could not be fully deleted. Please retry. Withdrawn files are no longer distributed.
artifacts.descriptionSetupWithdrawn: A current setup has been withdrawn. Older setups are not automatically activated for this target. Publish a new matching setup to distribute updates again.
artifacts.descriptionDisconnected: Establishing the live connection. Displayed status data may be outdated.

cluster.descriptionService: Monitor machines, services, and resource usage.
cluster.descriptionTasks: Track background tasks and their processing status.
cluster.descriptionArtifacts: Browse and manage published XRAG files.
